notes.title: The "QUICKPLAY" Update!
notes.notes:
[hr][/hr]
Eat. Sleep. Run. Repeat! 

Alex and Oscar here with some new content and bug fixes. Quickplay, a restart key, and the mysterious mouse clicking bug!

We are introducing QUICKPLAY in this update; a new option on the main menu which allows you to play any challenge you've encountered in the story. You'll be able to pre-select abilities and swap saves if you want to change your character upgrade status. Your global high scores will be tracked on this page.

Smaller updates include the much requested restart key. Hold down TAB (bindable) to instantly restart challenges and task terminals, no more fumbling through the pause screen! A fair amount of players reported mouse clicks not registering in game. This ended up being an issue tied to windows witchcraft. Please report if the issue persists!

We've got a small but mighty list of bullet points this update!

Added QUICKPLAY to the main menu, find challenges in any save file to unlock them here!
Added a RESTART button, holding this down will restart challenges and task terminals.
Fixed a bug where mouse clicks would not register for certain players.
Fixed a bug where certain bindings would be overridden when loading into zones.

You all have been incredibly helpful; please keep your eyes open for any further issues and let us know on our discord server. Feel free to post your times on our  Speedrun.com page and share your progress with us! Keep sending us your feedback and help us out with a positive review. Thank you all for the support!

[hr][/hr] See you at the finish line,
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Post-Release Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
[hr][/hr]
We hope you're enjoying TAGLINE! 

As with all new game releases it's customary to stumble across a few bugs, issues, and the stuff nightmares are made of! Luckily the NOTH team (Alex and Oscar) are here to save the day with our first post-release patch for TAGLINE. Our main focus was to eliminate rare softlocks and visual bugs. 

Thank you so much for the amazing feedback on our discord server; we're grateful for those of you who helped us spot some of these issues.

Here's a list of fresh bug fixes!

Players will no longer appear to have abilities equipped after death / challenges.
Fixed a bug that would let players softlock themselves after spawning into maps.
Added additional fail safes to some achievements.
Fixed a bug that would lock players inside the Black Book menu.
Fixed some issues with the blimp on MALL...
Fixed and added in the "Contact Sport" achievement.
Minor visual tweaks.

As always thanks for playing! It's been an awesome experience sharing this full game with you all, and it's great to see how much fun you're having! We are aware there may be other bugs and issues lurking around, so please keep sending us your feedback. Lastly, make sure to leave a positive review on steam this help us out tremendously!

[hr][/hr] Talk to you all soon!
The NOTH Team

notes.title: Demo Patch released
notes.notes:
[hr][/hr]
Hello all! 

It's the NOTH team (Alex and Oscar) here with a small patch to make your DEMO experience more enjoyable! Our biggest thanks to those who've tried/streamed/sent feedback our way.

Here's some small but notable things:

The windowed/full screen bug is fixed for demo players. (Beta update incoming)
Visual fixes; some funny things such as floating decals and haunted posters.
We now have colored text which helps distinguish ability names.
Some dialogue edits, collectable bugs, and secrets we cannot divulge here!

 As always thanks for playing. Make sure to wishlist the game if you haven't already as it helps us get noticed by the Steam algorithm! Whenever we see people share we sit back and stretch our horribly hunched backs, so for the love of our spine health - keep at it.

[hr][/hr] Till next time-
The NOTH Team
